description: This file contains a PHP class definition for the CustomerTransaction report controller in the OpenCart admin extension module. It handles various functionalities such as displaying, listing, and saving customer transaction reports, as well as generating report data and managing filters.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: PHP class controller handling customer transaction reports in OpenCart's admin extension. Includes methods for displaying, filtering, saving, and listing reports.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language strings, breadcrumbs, and views for the customer transaction report form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report configuration settings via POST request, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the customer transaction report data, sets up pagination, and renders the report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the report data obtained from getReport() function.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves report data based on filter parameters from GET request, returns data as a formatted string.
